# Now 2.10.70
- Fixed Check for Updates incorrectly reporting “up to date” when GitHub's raw-file CDN served a stale appcast. - Update checks now use the no-cache latest-release feed, with the previous release refreshed as a safe redirect fallback. - Publishing now reads the prior feed directly from GitHub's origin API and verifies the exact URL embedded in installed clients before declaring success. - Includes Apple Music previous/next artwork previews for album and playlist playback from 2.10.69.

# Now 2.10.69
- Apple Music album and playlist playback now previews the real previous or next cover while you swipe, using the track's exact embedded artwork. - Adjacent covers are prefetched in both directions and handed directly into the completed skip, preventing a duplicate artwork transition. - Playlist position is validated before every preview; first/last-track boundaries do not show stale artwork. - Shuffled and opaque streaming queues decline speculative next artwork because macOS does not expose their resolved Up Next order. - When Apple Music hides its queue, the previous cover still uses verified playback history instead of an unrelated playlist guess.

# Now 2.10.68
- Live Lyrics now appears beneath the song title and artist while album artwork remains visible and unchanged. - Lyric transitions use a smoother spring handoff: the outgoing line lifts away as the next line rises into place. - Synchronized lyric lines stay aligned between browser metadata updates, pauses, and seeks. - When synchronized lyrics are unavailable, the overlay now restores the original title-and-artist layout and spacing instead of showing a status message. - Long lyric lines now wrap across two readable lines instead of shrinking into tiny, truncated text. - Fixed Apple Music lyrics freezing between play/pause events by preserving a monotonic playback clock when MediaRemote repeats a stale elapsed value. - Added conservative music-video title and duration matching so official videos can resolve the same synchronized lyrics as their audio release. - Lyric rows now use their intrinsic one- or two-line height, removing the empty gap under short lyrics and keeping the title/artist/lyric group optically centered. - Added reduced-motion support, bounded caching, request timeouts, and track-change cancellation for efficient background behavior.
